commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question 'Auto-purge: how long should deleted notes stay in the trash before being purged?' \
  --context 'The storage bill doubled because the trash never purges; I will add an automatic purge.
7 days: about $5/month steady-state, but support can’t restore the 15% of requests that come after week 1.
30 days: about $20/month, covers the 85% of restore requests that come within 3 weeks, with buffer.
90 days: about $60/month, covers nearly every restore request.' \
  --option '30 days' --option '7 days' --option '90 days' \
  --recommended \
  --waiting
